baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite noun at word 2 is resumed as the object of the causative verb at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A route or means already extends toward an end; facilitation changes it from merely existing into being open and usable for passage.

activation_trace.role: The extended traversed way supplies the route or means that is acted upon.
Ease and ready opening supplies the causative change from available in principle to traversable in practice.

changed_reading.after: He readied an extended means of passage so that it could actually be entered and traversed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The path noun at word 2 can metonymically evoke its users, while the verb at word 3 carries a movement-quality branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The people-of-the-road branch shifts attention from terrain alone to the traveler, and pliant movement makes facilitation a fit between mover and route.

activation_trace.role: Road-users and travelers supply the moving participant latent inside the named road.
Light, pliant movement supplies the traveler's fitted responsiveness to the course.

changed_reading.before: The terrain is made easy while the traveler remains implicit.
changed_reading.after: The course is fitted to a mobile creature, coupling the traveler's capacity with the road's affordance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The path noun at word 2 has both downward-release and front-opening branches, and word 3 can make an opening ready.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taken together, lowering from above and a rim or front outlet spatialize the path as a descending conduit whose exit is prepared.

activation_trace.role: Letting something down from above supplies the conduit with a descending direction.
A rim or front opening supplies the terminal aperture through which passage can occur.
Ready opening makes the inferred descending outlet passable rather than sealed.

changed_reading.before: The path is a horizontal road.
changed_reading.after: The path can be a prepared downward passage ending in an outlet or threshold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots at words 2 and 3 independently contain grain, prosperity, and productive-livestock branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: An extended ear of grain joins prosperity and reproductive yield, recasting facilitation as making a means productive rather than merely reducing friction.

activation_trace.role: The extended ear of grain supplies a growth-bearing form of the path noun.
Prosperity and means supplies abundance as one possible result of facilitation.
Increase in milk and offspring supplies concrete biological yield to the productive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Ease concerns the smoothness of travel.
changed_reading.after: Facilitation can mean making the appointed means grow, yield, and sustain life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus roots carry independent branches from the domain of gambling arrows, lots, and apportioned shares.
baseline_models.mechanism: The named gaming arrow in the path root and the lots-and-shares branch in the facilitation root form an unusually exact internal collision: the course can be heard as a lot or portion dealt out.

activation_trace.role: The gaming arrow named al-musbil supplies the concrete lot attached to the path root.
Gaming lots and division into shares supplies the act of apportioning a received portion.

changed_reading.after: A creature's course is dealt or allotted as its portion, with the chance-like image still awaiting contextual control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast turns route-readiness into an access relation: withdrawn attention obstructs, while a sight-limited person arrives with purposeful motion toward a reminder. The path is facilitated when the seeker is admitted to guidance, not merely when terrain is smooth.

activation_trace.role: The traversed route supplies the access channel that can connect seeker and reminder.
Ready opening supplies accessibility as the focus action.
Turning away supplies a social closure that functions as the inverse of an opened route.
Arrival supplies an actual entrant for whom the route's accessibility matters.
Loss of sight supplies a concrete access constraint rather than a lack of desire to travel.
The reminder supplies the destination or guide to which the facilitated route gives access.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end supplies active traversal by the seeker.

structural_cues: The opening ayat contrast turning away with a blind person's arrival, striving, and fear.
The reminder is presented as available to whoever wills before the creation sequence reaches the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies closure, arrival, impaired sight, purposeful movement, and a reminder. I infer that making the path ready includes removing social and cognitive access barriers. A live alternative is that the opening episode and the later path remain thematically parallel but referentially separate.

changed_reading.before: God makes a neutral route easy.
changed_reading.after: God makes a route to recollection genuinely accessible to the one who comes seeking, which exposes selective attention as route-blocking behavior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fluid origin, creation, and measured formation activate the focus-only descending-outlet model. The prepared path becomes a bodily transit from contained formation through an opening, while the broader life-course reading remains live.

activation_trace.role: Downward release supplies a possible direction for embodied emergence.
The front opening supplies the aperture through which the formed subject can pass.
Ready opening supplies the enabling action at the threshold.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the formed subject who undergoes the passage.
Clear fluid ranging from droplet to semen supplies the subject's contained material origin.
Measured limit supplies bodily proportion and a bounded pre-passage state.

structural_cues: The focus follows fluid creation and measured formation with an explicit then.
The masculine object suffix continues across created him, measured him, and made it or him easy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fluid origin, formed measure, a descending image, and a front opening. I infer a directional arrow from gestation to bodily emergence through a prepared outlet. A live alternative is that the sequence names only a general life-course and not a specific birth passage.

changed_reading.before: The path is an abstract course assigned after creation.
changed_reading.after: The first instance of that course may be embodied emergence itself: a measured creature is enabled to pass from containment through a prepared opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death, grave concealment, and renewed opening turn the singular path into the connective operation between successive states. Facilitation is not only ease within life but enabled transfer into, through, and out of bounded conditions.

activation_trace.role: The extended traversed way supplies continuity across otherwise discontinuous states.
Ready opening supplies the enabling operation for each transition.
Loss of force and life supplies the first post-focus boundary crossing.
Concealment of the dead in a grave supplies an enclosed intermediate station.
Opening, spreading, and branching supplies movement back out of enclosure.
Reviving the dead supplies the explicit state reversal reached by that reopening.

structural_cues: The focus is one member of a repeated then-sequence: path, death and burial, then renewed raising.
The same human object remains under divine causation across the sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered state changes and repeated openings or enclosures. I infer that the path functions as their connective transit rather than only as an episode inside the first state. A live alternative restricts the path to earthly conduct before death.

changed_reading.before: The path is the human lifespan between birth and death.
changed_reading.after: The path is a sequence of divinely enabled transits, including entry into concealment and reopening beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later food sequence externalizes the focus's latent descent-and-yield cluster: water is poured, conveyed downward, earth is opened, vegetation emerges, grain bears, and livestock receives the result. A path made easy becomes an ecological channel whose successful passage is visible as yield.

activation_trace.role: Letting down from above supplies the vertical direction of the provisioning channel.
Falling rain supplies water in transit between sky and earth as a literal path-like flow.
The extended grain ear supplies the channel's terminal plant yield.
Ready opening supplies unblocked transfer through each stage of the cascade.
Productive increase in livestock supplies the downstream biological result of successful throughput.
Pouring and outflow supplies the initiating movement of water into the channel.
Conveying water by irrigation or pouring supplies directed transfer rather than static substance.
Splitting and opening supplies the earth aperture that receives and releases the flow.
Vegetation coming out of earth supplies emergence from the opened substrate.
The seed that grows and bears grain supplies reproducible yield at the plant stage.
Livestock wealth supplies the animal recipient that closes the provisioning circuit.

structural_cues: The food unit forms an explicit causal sequence from poured water through split earth to plants, human use, and livestock use.
Its downward flow and upward emergence reverse direction while remaining one provisioning circuit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each material stage but does not call the whole cascade a path. I infer the channel relation linking water descent, opened earth, emergence, and yield. A live alternative is that this sequence analogizes the human path without specifying the focus noun's referent.

changed_reading.before: Grain and livestock yield are remote focus-root side branches.
changed_reading.after: The later material sequence makes them a coherent model: God facilitates a route of provision by opening passage from water to earth to plant to creature.

context_deltas.mechanism: The path root's eye-film branch turns obstruction into occlusion. Sight loss, directed looking, uncovering, and a context branch that itself names a clear evident road then recast facilitation as making the course perceptible, not just physically smooth.

activation_trace.role: An eye film like webbing supplies visual obstruction as a path problem.
Ready opening supplies relief from occlusion and availability to perception.
Loss of sight supplies the opening instance of blocked visual access.
Removing a cover supplies disclosure at the bright-face end of the visual arc.
Directed sight or insight supplies the active operation by which the route is discerned.
A clear evident road supplies an explicit context-root bridge back to the focus path.

structural_cues: The surah opens with blindness, later commands looking, and closes with contrasted face surfaces.
Uncovered brightness and overlaid dust produce opposite visibility states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight loss, looking, uncovering, a clear-road branch, and the focus eye-film image. I infer that ease can operate at the level of recognizability. A live alternative is that these visual cues frame accountability while the focus still denotes only a physical or existential route.

changed_reading.before: The route is easy because movement along it is unimpeded.
changed_reading.after: The route is easy because it is made discernible through lifted occlusion, directed attention, and visible disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact lots-and-shares collision inside the focus is disciplined by surrounding measure and decisive settlement. The course becomes an allotted portion under design: lottery-like from the recipient's limited view, but measured rather than random in the sequence.

activation_trace.role: The named gaming arrow supplies the focus's concrete lot image.
Lots and division of a camel into shares supplies apportionment as the focus action's latent domain.
Estimating and measuring a thing supplies prior design rather than arbitrary dealing.
Ordering an affair by measure and deliberation controls the apparent chance of the lot image.
Decisive judgment supplies settlement and obligation at the far end of the apportioned course.

structural_cues: Measured him immediately precedes then the path, creating a tight measure-to-course sequence.
The later statement that the commanded matter is not yet completed keeps the course answerable to a settled demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two independent focus branches from lot-play, then measure and decisive judgment. I infer a shift from gaming share to assigned life-portion. A live alternative is accidental homonymy: the lot branches may resonate without licensing any course-level apportionment.

changed_reading.before: The lots reading suggests contingency or chance.
changed_reading.after: The creature receives a measured course as an allotted share, preserving the lot image while reversing randomness into deliberate apportionment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence supplies the negative image of focus facilitation: covering, dust-colored opacity, an overtaking layer, and constriction accumulate on faces. Ease now includes preserving an opening against enclosure and occlusion, while the final state shows that opening's inverse.

activation_trace.role: The web-like eye film supplies a focus-anchored image of opacity and obstructed orientation.
Ready opening supplies the positive condition reversed by the final coverings.
Covering supplies the terminal act that negates disclosure.
Dust and earth-colored film supplies the visible material of occlusion on the face.
Overtaking and overpowering supplies the directional arrival of the covering layer.
Constriction and reduction supplies the spatial opposite of a ready opening.

structural_cues: The final face pair contrasts unveiled brightness with a surface progressively covered by dust and darkness.
The covering sequence is layered: dust is on the faces, then another darkness overtakes them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, dust, overtaking, and constriction but does not explicitly call them a blocked path. I infer a reversal relation to the focus's ready opening. A live alternative is that the closing imagery names outcome and identity without revising the mechanics of the earlier path.

changed_reading.before: Ease is a generic positive property of the route.
changed_reading.after: Ease is an opened and perceptible condition whose exact inverse appears at the end as layered covering, overpowering, and constriction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the final flight does not grammatically modify the focus and reverses the usual positive value of ease. It remains anchored in the focus's road-user and light-movement branches and in explicit flight from named kin. Render it only as an end-context inversion showing the moral ambiguity of mobility, not as the primary lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The path noun at word 2 can evoke its traveler, and the verb root at word 3 can evoke quick, pliant movement.

activation_trace.role: People of the road supplies a mobile person rather than an inert strip of terrain.
Light and compliant movement supplies the capacity for rapid departure.
Flight and escape supplies the later use to which facilitated mobility is put.
Brotherhood and kinship supplies the first social bond from which the route leads away.
Companionship and close association supplies another bond severed by solitary movement.
Filiation and descent supplies the generational relation that flight also leaves behind.

changed_reading.before: Facilitated movement is simply a gift that advances the traveler.
changed_reading.after: The same fitted mobility can become a route of solitary escape from every companion and descendant when relations no longer carry the traveler.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly cross-domain because the focus surface ordinarily presents a path, while the supporting context surfaces do not themselves name anatomy. It remains worth carrying because the focus branch supplies a front throat opening and the packet activates the rear mouth, oral intake, and esophagus branches. Render it explicitly as a physiological analogy for provision becoming usable, never as a claim that the focus noun simply means digestive tract.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The path root at word 2 contains a front throat or vessel-opening branch, while word 3 can ready an opening.

activation_trace.role: The front throat or vessel opening supplies an anatomical entry point for a bodily passage.
Ready opening supplies unobstructed intake through the inferred channel.
The flesh at the rear of the mouth over the throat supplies the channel's inner threshold.
Mutual oral feeding supplies passage of provision through the mouth.
The esophagus supplies the internal continuation of the front opening despite the context surface's different sense.

changed_reading.before: Provision travels on an external ecological route.
changed_reading.after: Provision also requires a made-ready internal passage from mouth through throat, making bodily uptake a miniature path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because eye webbing and palm lines are distant branches of the focus surfaces, and a road is not explicitly called writing. It remains anchored through the focus's visual mesh and separate-line branches plus the packet's written pages, hands, and revealing book. Render it as a graphic analogy in which a course becomes legible, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots at words 2 and 3 can activate a web-like visual trace and separated lines or bodily marks.

activation_trace.role: The web-like eye film supplies a visible network whose lines can obscure or guide reading.
Separate palm lines and body marks supplies the graphic trace into which the course is recast.
A written page supplies the surface on which a route-like line can become legible.
The physical hand supplies both the bearer of pages and the body surface associated with line marks.
The book that reveals what is written supplies disclosure and readability to the inscribed course.

changed_reading.after: The course can also be imagined as a line made legible on a surface, a trace to be read as well as a road to be walked.

strongest_changes: The opening access contrast revised an easy road into a route made available to an impaired but purposeful seeker.
Creation, death, burial, and renewed opening expanded the path into embodied emergence and repeated state transit.
The water-earth-plant-livestock sequence strongly activated a descending and productive ecological channel.
The double lots-and-shares collision, controlled by measure and judgment, produced a live allotted-course reading.
Blindness, looking, uncovering, and a clear-road branch changed ease from smooth motion into perceptibility.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two small roots generated several independent cross-domain couplings rather than one synonym chain: road and readiness, traveler and pliant motion, outlet and descent, grain and productive livestock, and two matching lot inventories. Context did not collapse them; it selectively strengthened bodily, ecological, epistemic, temporal, and apportional mechanisms while also supplying final reversals.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun and sequence do not decide whether the primary passage is birth, terrestrial conduct, the whole life-death-revival arc, or a deliberately layered combination.
The exact double-lot activation may be structurally meaningful or an unusually vivid homonymic coincidence.
The visual, alimentary, flight, and inscribed-route models remain analogical and should retain explicit exploratory containment.
The ecological channel may specify the focus mechanism or may function only as a later material analogy for it.
